issues.on_page: Line 18 Local Receipts: Other, Enterprise Funds column 32,369.59
issues.issue: The report only says 'Other'. The extractor presumes these are utility fund collections (Solid Waste and Water are the only enterprise spending). If that presumption is kept, the user rule (2026-10-28) puts utility fund sales/charges, including garbage, in Utility Charges, not charges for services/fees.
